NONE: › made or happening only for a particular purpose or need, not planned before it happens
特別的，專門的；臨時安排的

example: We deal with problems on an ad hoc basis (= as they happen).
我們應對問題的方式是只要出現就隨時解決。
"Why was she such a lousy boss?" "Oh, because she was unreasonable, disrespectful, rude, inconsiderate - I could go on ad infinitum."
「她怎麼是個這麼討厭的老闆呢？」「噢，因為她不可理喻、傲慢無禮、粗魯蠻橫、麻木不仁——你想聽多少我都可以列出來。」

NONE: › said without any preparation or practice
› to speak in public without having planned what to say

example: I'd forgotten the notes for my speech so I had to do it ad lib.
我演講時忘了帶稿，只好即興發揮。
She ad-libbed her way through the entire speech.
她整場演講都是即興作出的。

NONE: › If someone discusses something ad nauseam, they talk about it so much that it becomes very boring.
喋喋不休地，令人厭煩地

example: He talks ad nauseam about how clever his children are.
他喋喋不休地說著他的孩子有多聰明，真是令人生厭。
